variables.manual_run: {{ not (trigger is defined and trigger.id is defined) }}
variables.target_expanded_entities: {% set ns = namespace(entities=[]) %} {% for d in target_ids.devices %}{% set ns.entities = ns.entities + device_entities(d) %}{% endfor %} {% for a in target_ids.areas %}{% set ns.entities = ns.entities + area_entities(a) %}{% endfor %} {{ ns.entities | unique | list }}
variables.reachable_entities:
{{ resolved_entities | reject('is_state', 'unavailable') | reject('is_state', 'unknown')
   | reject('in', hands_off_entities) | list }}
variables.room_occupancy_entities:
{{ all_target_entities | select('match', '^binary_sensor\\.')
   | select('is_state_attr', 'device_class', 'occupancy') | list
   + all_target_entities | select('match', '^binary_sensor\\.')
   | select('is_state_attr', 'device_class', 'motion') | list }}
variables.occupied: {# The room is in use if anything is already on. #} {{ resolved_entities | map('states') | select('eq', 'on') | list | count > 0 }}
variables.entities_still_on:
{{ resolved_entities | select('is_state', 'on')
   | reject('in', hands_off_entities) | reject('in', idle_entities) | list }}
variables.phase_scene: {% set m = {'Morning': morning_scene, 'Day': day_scene, 'Evening': evening_scene, 'Night': night_scene} %} {{ m.get(phase) }}
variables.handed_off_entities: {{ ((scene_covered_entities if scene_active else []) + hands_off_entities) | unique | list }}
variables.scene_recheck_due: {{ not (trigger is defined and trigger.id is defined and trigger.id == 'tick') }}
variables.target_entities: {{ resolved_entities | reject('in', scene_covered_entities) | list if scene_active else resolved_entities }}

choose.alias: Motion timed out and the room is confirmed empty

conditions.alias: Every occupancy sensor has been clear for the full Wait time

sequence.alias: Leave the idle-brightness lights dimly lit

if.alias: Room has idle-brightness lights to dim

choose.alias: Self-heal: retry an earlier turn-off that didn't land

conditions.alias: Triggered by the periodic tick or a phase change
Room has an occupancy sensor to reconcile against
Occupancy has been clear for the full Wait time
Something in the room is still on

sequence.alias: Self-heal: retry turning off lights left on with no occupancy

default.alias: Settle an empty room to its idle brightness

if.alias: Room is idle, and the sensor has a colour target
if.value_template: {{ room_is_idle and color_temp_kelvin is not none }}

default.alias: Only motion, a manual run, or a room already in use may switch a light on

if.alias: Allowed to turn on, and not already handled by the idle nightlight

then.alias: Activate a scene, if one applies and is due a recheck

if.alias: A scene applies and is due a recheck

then.alias: Apply adaptive lighting, unless the sensor has no target to apply

if.alias: Sensor has a real brightness and colour target
if.value_template: {{ brightness is not none and color_temp_kelvin is not none }}

default.alias: Release lights handed off to a scene or another owner

conditions.alias: Every trigger passes except an unproductive motion_on tick

or.alias: A motion_on run with something to actually turn on

and.alias: Something in the room is off, or has an idle level
and.value_template:
{{ resolved_entities | map('states') | select('ne', 'on') | list | count > 0
   or idle_entities | length > 0 }}
